access.notes: Open‑source; supports PBE and HSE06 with spin‑orbit coupling. Alternative: VASP (proprietary). The agent may use any DFT code capable of PBE/HSE06+SOC.

resources.name: Pseudopotential library for PBE and HSE06

access.notes: Standard solid‑state pseudopotentials (SSSP) or PSLibrary; any reliable set covering V, Nb, Ta, Ti, Zr, Hf, C, F is acceptable.

The hexagonal P‑3m1 structure and atomic positions are publicly known; the agent can construct them from the task description or standard crystallographic tools. No specific external file is required.
